newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS upgrades Swiss Re to 'buy' from 'hold'.
newsitem.headline: UBS upgrades Swiss Re to 'buy' from 'hold'.

text.p: UBS said it had upgraded its recommendation for Swiss Re shares to buy from hold and boosted its earnings forecast for the reinsurer.
"During a company visit chief executive Walter Kielholz confirmed to us the clearly improved medium-term earnings outlook," analyst Thomas Kalbermatten wrote in a report.

"We therefore are raising our 1997 earnings estimate to 1,600 million Swiss francs from 1,500 million and to 1,850 million from 1,630 million for 1998 and switching Swiss Re to buy from hold," he wrote. It set a price target of 1,900 francs per share at end-1997.
